verses.1: Therefore, by abandoning the teachings of the founder of Christ’s religion, we have brought it to completion. Once again, we have laid the foundation for a life of repentance from dead works, and for faith in God.
verses.2: It teaches baptism by direct hand gestures, as well as by the resurrection of the dead and eternal punishment.
verses.3: And we shall do this if God permits it.
verses.4: For it was impossible for those who were illuminated by the light of heaven to be also blessed with the gifts of heaven, as well as to receive the spirit of holiness.
verses.5: And those who have tasted the goodness of God’s blessings will also possess the power of the future year.
verses.6: And when they fall, they must be renewed anew through reflection. They must bear witness to the son of God and set an example for others.
verses.7: For the earth, after receiving many things from those who come upon it, she absorbs that fertility into herself. Thus, she becomes a source of blessing for those who cultivate it. In this way, she receives blessings from God.
verses.8: I also brought forth ugly and unpleasant things, as well as those who were harmful and dangerous. This was to bring about destruction.
verses.9: Let us also discuss these matters regarding you, beloved ones, about those who are in need of salvation. Even though we speak in this way…
verses.10: For it is not unjust for God to reject your efforts and the love you have shown in serving Him. You have indeed served the saints and obeyed His commands.
verses.11: We desire, however, that each of you should strive to fully understand the nature of hope.
verses.12: So that you do not become enemies, but rather followers who inherit the teachings through faith and perseverance.
verses.13: For the Abraham, God said that since he had no one else to whom he could be like, then he should be like himself.
verses.14: Saying: “But if I do not bless you, then I will bless you in abundance.”
verses.15: And in this way, his patience was rewarded, and his request was granted.
verses.16: For people, according to the majority’s opinion, they will be considered wrongful. And in every case, their disagreement will lead to their conviction.
verses.17: In order to ensure that the descendants of those who received this inheritance would be able to carry out the instructions of God, God made it necessary for them to swear an oath.
verses.18: In order to be able to move forward through these two matters, in which it is impossible to lie to God, we must have a strong determination to keep our hope alive.
verses.19: What kind of “free” do we have in our souls? It’s a free that is safe, reliable, and truly secure, and it can be entered into the higher realm of existence.
verses.20: Where Jesus entered for our sake, in accordance with the order of Melchizedek, the high priest, who became king during that time.
